coordinatorVerification.fixtureTimeoutFix: The first seven-class run failed AttachedFailureRetainsPassedOwnerWithoutWaitingForPeerAsync(beforeOwner: True) with HXT007/HXT002: its delayed native fixture sleeps 1 s against the fixture execution limit of 2 s. OwnerRun now raises executionTimeoutSeconds to 60 for delayNative as it already did for blockNative.
coordinatorVerification.crossClassInterference: CancellationPublicationRefusalPreservesLiveAppHostAsync asserts that a live fake AppHost tagged with the shared fixed run id CompositionTestFiles.RunId survives. It failed in both seven-class runs at the same position and passed everywhere else: 3 isolated reruns, 2 runs paired with its predecessor, the attach class alone and three bisect combinations. CompositionRunResourceScanner discovers run processes machine-wide through /proc/*/environ, so any teardown for that shared run id stops the AppHost. This test-isolation hazard predates this pass and is recorded in the Platform deferred-work ledger.
